propertySets.name: Pset_SensorTypeEarthquakeSensor
propertySets.definition: Properties that are applicable for IfcSensor with predefined type EARTHQUAKESENSOR.

properties.name: MarginOfError
properties.definition: Indicates the margin of error of the measurement.

properties.name: LinearVelocityResolution
properties.definition: Indicates the resolution of the detected linear velocity.

properties.name: SamplingFrequency
properties.definition: Indicates the sampling frequency of the device.

properties.name: WorkingState
properties.definition: Indicates the working state of device or system.

properties.name: DataCollectionType
properties.definition: Indicates the type or manner of data collection.

properties.name: DegreeOfLinearity
properties.definition: Indicates the degree of linearity of the earthquake sensor or accelerometer.

properties.name: DynamicRange
properties.definition: Indicates the dynamic range of the sensor.

properties.name: EarthquakeSensorRange
properties.definition: Indicates the measuring range of the earthquake sensor or accelerometer.

properties.name: FullScaleOutput
properties.definition: Indicates the full scale output of the earthquake sensor or accelerometer.

properties.name: SerialInterfaceType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of serial interface used by the device.

properties.name: TransverseSensitivityRatio
properties.definition: Indicates the transverse sensitivity ratio of the sensor.

properties.name: EarthquakeSensorType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of earthquake sensor or accelerometer.
